nodes.text: The handset is warm. Someone left it a minute ago.

nodes.speaker: PARTH
nodes.text: Control to all towers. Generator test on the south feed. Lamps off till I call it back.

nodes.speaker: TOWER TWO
nodes.text: In this rain? Who's on the desk?

nodes.speaker: PARTH
nodes.text: Duty officer. Rathore wants it logged. Lamps off.

nodes.speaker: TOWER ONE
nodes.text: One. Somebody's getting shouted at in the morning.
